name: Ikenie no Kyoushitsu
source:
Main heroine helps a bullied girl and becomes a target of bullying herself. She is insulted every day from then on. The only way out boys suggest is offer someone else as sacrifice, and protagonist points to her best friend without knowing what kind of tragedy it's about to produce.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角帮助了一名遭受欺凌的女孩，自己却因此成为新的霸凌目标，从此每天都饱受羞辱。男生们告诉她，唯一的脱身方法就是献出另一个人作为祭品。她在不知道会酿成何等悲剧的情况下，指向了自己最要好的朋友。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
